rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof structure is straightforward property damage with no third-party involvement or vehicle involvement.
claim_summary: Wind damage to back porch roof overhang; four shingles blown off last weekend with no water intrusion. Estimated repair cost $400. Policyholder has $2,500 deductible; damage is below deductible threshold and likely not payable, but routed for adjuster review to confirm no additional hidden damage.

case_facts.description: four shingles blown off by wind last weekend; no water intrusion
